checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Uses attached cat photo, same cat and sofa
must.why: Cat and sofa match the input.
Reads WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY.

must.item: Large white letters with black outlines, visible, readable
must.why: Bold white condensed caps with black outline; fully visible. Letters slightly tight.
Eyes clear; the top text overlaps only the ear tips; image is square.

faults.what: Letters are tightly packed and the outline is a bit thin, so the words nearly touch. It is still readable.
The top text slightly touches the cat's ear tips.

summary: A clean square cat meme with both captions spelled correctly in white letters with black outlines, and the eyes clear; only the tight letter spacing is a minor flaw.
